Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: host agency share, minimum score, the weights of the scorecard, days to solve an issue and the income per hour you want.
Check Team and Trips. They hold the people and the trips that the other sheets look up.
Fill Suppliers with each supplier, its contact, commission rate, deposit and final payment terms and its group. Bookings, sales, commission, score and payment check fill in for you.
Keep Bookings, Commissions and Supplier Payments up to date. Days to pay, unpaid commission and the chase step show which supplier pays late.
Score each supplier every quarter on Supplier Scorecards. The weighted score uses the weights from Start and marks a supplier below your minimum.
Write contacts on Supplier Contacts and the contract dates on Supplier Terms. The renewal step warns you before the terms end.
Log every problem on Supplier Issues with its cost, and track the preferred deals on Preferred Deals and each training on Familiarisation Trips.
Keep Service Fees and Service Fee Schedule current, and write every fee change on Fee Reviews.
Read Trip Profitability to see net earnings, margin and income per hour of every trip, and Supplier Categories and Sales by Month for the yearly picture.
Use Destination Suppliers and Replacement Options to choose the best supplier for a trip and to plan a switch.
Use the 14 calculators to score suppliers, compare them, check a trip profit, compare commission with a fee, track a bonus, test concentration, review fees and plan what-ifs.
Read the Supplier Dashboard and Charts every week: sales, commission, scores, issues, fees and margin.
Know your cash, your profit and your safe draw every month
Cash runway and cash floor warning
bank cash, client money and running costs give the months of cover and the date cash reaches your floor
money collected for suppliers is tracked month by month against bank cash so your own money is never a guess
commissions, fees, expenses and advisor payouts become profit and margin for each month and the year to date
profit, your rate and the instalments paid show what to set aside and what each instalment needs
profit after tax and reserve gives the draw the business can carry each month
trips, commission, host agency share and payout show what each advisor earns the business
earnings, host agency share, payouts and advisor hours show which trip types pay for the time they take
booked sales, commission rates and supplier terms show the commission and fees arriving each month
overheads, owner draw and net earnings per trip give the trips you need each month
advisors, repeat and referral shares and the peak months show the trips, income and the cash to save for the quiet months

One row per month: money in from clients, fees and commissions, money out to suppliers, advisors, the owner and costs; net cash, closing cash, months of cover and the floor check fill in.
Income by month against the forecast
One row per month: commissions kept after the host agency share, fees and other income, with your forecast; total income, the gap to the forecast and growth on the month before fill in.
One row per commission from a supplier: the amount expected, when it should arrive, what arrived, and the host agency and advisor shares; days late, share of income and who to chase fill in.
One row per service fee: planning, booking, change, cancellation and consultation fees with the invoice date and payment; the open amount, days open and a chase check fill in.
Client money held for suppliers by month
One row per month: client payments collected for suppliers and what was paid on to them; the balance held, the bank cash and your own money fill in so you see if client money is covered.
One row per business expense: date, category, vendor, amount and how it was paid; the month and a large-expense check fill in.
Expense budget against this year so far
One row per expense category: your monthly budget; the budget so far this year, the actual spent and the gap fill in from Expenses.
One row per advisor and month: the agency share of the commissions they brought, their rate and what was paid; the expected pay, a match check and the year so far fill in.
One row per month: what the owner took out; the profit of the month, the share of it taken, the safe draw after the tax set-aside and the year so far fill in.
One row per instalment: the period, due date, amount and status; the days to the due date and a due-soon check fill in.
One row per month: the rate and the amount you moved aside; the profit, the amount the rate asks for, the gap and the balance after instalments paid fill in.
One row per month: income, expenses and advisor payouts come from the other sheets; profit, margin, the owner draw, what is left after it and the year to date fill in by themselves.
Profit by trip type and year
One row per trip type and year of travel: the hours spent and the costs (host agency share, advisor payouts and advisor time); trips, sales, earnings, profit and profit per trip fill in from Trips.
One row per advisor and year of travel: the payouts made; trips, sales, earnings, the host agency share, profit and the share of the year profit fill in from Trips.
One row per trip: type, advisor, dates, price, supplier net, expected commission and service fee; earnings, host agency share, advisor payout, net earnings and earnings as a share of price fill in.
Marketing spend, leads and bookings by source
One row per month and source: spend, leads, enquiries, bookings and sales; the cost per booking, the return and a pays-back check fill in.
One row per review: date, client, trip, rating from 1 to 5, source and comment; a happy, neutral or unhappy check fills in.
One row per goal: the start value, today value, target and due date; progress, days left and an on-track check fill in.
One row per month ahead: trips starting, expected commission, fees and costs; expected income, net and a cash-needed check fill in.
Team with advisor rate and earnings
One row per team member: role, hours, advisor rate and contact; the trips handled and the earnings brought in fill in from Trips.

Hello, the profit and loss for {month} is ready: income {income}, expenses {expenses}, advisor payouts {payouts}, profit {profit}. The margin is {margin}.
Hello, cash at the end of {month} is {closing}, which covers {cover} months of running costs. Floor check: {floor_flag}. Please review the cash plan.

Hello, spending on {category} is {actual} against a budget of {budget_ytd} so far this year. Budget check: {status}.
Owner: income is below the forecast
Hello, income for {month} is {total_income} against a forecast of {forecast}, a gap of {gap}.
